title: Two helical members keyed to a cross shaft
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) and C (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. The solid key makes A and K rotate together. A positive, K positive. External mesh A/B (30/90 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, B negative. Equal flank-normal speeds on the two unwrapped pitch surfaces require opposite rotation, since their CW motions cross a tooth in opposite senses. K positive, I negative. The solid key makes I and J rotate together. I negative, J negative. Equal flank-normal speeds on the two unwrapped pitch surfaces require opposite rotation, since their CW motions cross a tooth in opposite senses. J negative, C positive. The requested motion is CCW / CW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: B
options.explanation: B must be CCW. External mesh A/B (30/90 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, B negative.. C must be CW. Equal flank-normal speeds on the two unwrapped pitch surfaces require opposite rotation, since their CW motions cross a tooth in opposite senses. J negative, C positive..

options.label: C
options.explanation: C must be CW. Equal flank-normal speeds on the two unwrapped pitch surfaces require opposite rotation, since their CW motions cross a tooth in opposite senses. J negative, C positive..

options.label: D
options.explanation: B must be CCW. External mesh A/B (30/90 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, B negative..
